name: astral-orchestrator
description: Beginner-friendly, model-routed orchestration with explicit Measured evidence runs for planning, delegating, verifying, and reviewing project work in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Simple, risk-aware delivery for any project.
interface.longDescription: Astral Orchestrator turns an everyday request into a clear outcome, keeps the Sol model in charge, routes bounded work to pinned Luna or Terra models at their configured efforts, verifies the actual result, and uses a fresh Sol reviewer before handoff. Its explicit Measured mode adds a deliberately slower local evidence ledger without changing the pinned routes.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral Orchestrator to complete this request and verify the result.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Measured mode for this evidence-oriented request.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Careful mode for this risky change.
